name: f02_orientation
notes: A focus-less recall is the session-boot call (spec §6): `focus` is replaced by an `overview` object {elements, relations, clock, scope, active} (pin §3.15), sections scoped store-wide. M4 update (as the M3 notes anticipated): active ranks by activation x recency (score = activation * last_seen; ties last_seen desc then id desc), cap 5, eligibility = live non-seed non-attribute-name elements that carry a summary or sit in the subject slot of a live non-expects relation — so the leaf value #45 'active' no longer pollutes the list, and #42 platformer ranks first (touched at ticks 1 and 3: highest activation x recency). Overview counts are arena totals incl. the 42 seed elements / 10 seed relations. Ids (0-based, reconciled): #42 platformer, #43 constraint instance, #44 current_standing, #45 active, #46 question instance, #47 gravity; rel:10/12/14 instance_of, rel:11 standing cache, rel:13 fact.

steps.notes: constraint mint side-effect: current_standing = active cache (spec §5), minting #45 current_standing and #46 active (README assumption 7)
no `focus` key in an orientation frame; focus-shaped entries omit kind/summary when absent (the §3.15 exception to the no-omission rule)
